      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "马基·埃亚尔的野外不是个安全的地方。野兽和到处游荡的龙似乎是巨大的威胁，然而真正危险的是两条腿的人。窃贼、强盗、刺客、投机冒险家、疯狂的巫师，甚至憎恶魔法的狂热者，都会给那些走出安全城墙的冒险者带来危险。"

      "section": "mod-tome/data/birth/classes/rogue.lua",
      "source": "Amidst this chaos wanders one class of rogue that has learned to take by force rather than subterfuge. With refined techniques, agile feats and brawn-backed blades the Marauder seeks out his targets and removes them by the most direct methods. He uses dual weapons backed by advanced combat training to become highly effective in battle, and he is unafraid to use the dirtiest tactics when the odds are against him.",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "在这片混乱之中，游荡着一类学会了以武力而非诡计夺取所需的盗贼。凭借精湛的技巧、敏捷的身手和蛮力加持的刀刃，掠夺者搜寻目标，并以最直接的方式将其除掉。他们以高等战斗训练为后盾双持武器，在战斗中极具威力；形势不利时，他们也不惮使用最卑劣的手段。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "a90a256ea558a7aca5145c6c70fa6801e3bba4e0fb054a6261972f4fdccf08e7",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0041 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/birth/classes/rogue.lua",
      "source": "While able to take maximum advantage of their sling by using deft movements to avoid and confuse enemies that try to get close, the Skirmisher truly excels when fighting other ranged users.",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "虽然散兵能借助灵巧的移动躲避并迷惑试图接近的敌人，从而最大程度地发挥投石索的威力，但他们真正擅长的是与其他远程单位作战。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "a1fbff113fb14088c7265b35051276e69fc9cc31169822156c7f22974178b354",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0041 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/birth/classes/rogue.lua",
      "source": "They have mastered the use of their shield as well as their sling and are nearly impossible to defeat in a standoff.",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "他们既精通投石索，也精通盾牌的使用，在远距离对峙中几乎无人能击败他们。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "7143c3ac2fd07945b151bdd620aaeedc2d00b9322e228a9c5c7010c018913195",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0041 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/birth/classes/rogue.lua",
      "source": "Shadowblades are Rogues that are touched by the gift of magic, able to kill with their daggers under a veil of stealth while casting spells to enhance their performance and survival.",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "影舞者是拥有魔法天赋的盗贼，能在潜行的掩护下用匕首杀敌，同时施展法术增强战斗和生存能力。"
    }
